translations.literal: Now the state wishes to pray for spiritual response and should display extraordinary ritual; we have deliberated and request that he be further enfeoffed as King of Spiritual Response.
translations.idiomatic: Now the state wishes to pray for a spiritual response and should bestow extraordinary honors; we have deliberated and request that he be further enfeoffed as King of Spiritual Response.

sentences.zh: 從之。）〉

translations.literal: Granted.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Granted.)〉

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞進封北平王，青州節度使房知溫進封東平王。

translations.literal: Zhao Dejun, military governor of Youzhou, was advanced to King of Northern Ping; Fang Zhiwen, military governor of Qingzhou, was advanced to King of Eastern Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun, military governor of Youzhou, was advanced to King of Northern Ping, and Fang Zhiwen, military governor of Qingzhou, was advanced to King of Eastern Ping.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以前鄜州節度使索自通為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Suo Zitong, former military governor of Binzhou, was made commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Suo Zitong, former military governor of Binzhou, was appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇子左衛上將軍重美加檢校太保、同平章事，充鎮州節度使兼河南尹，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Chongmei, the prince and general of the Left Guard, was given the additional titles of honorary grand guardian and fellow chief councilor, appointed military governor of Zhenzhou and concurrently magistrate of Henan, and assigned to oversee the six armies and all guard units.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the prince Chongmei, general of the Left Guard, was given the additional titles of honorary grand guardian and fellow chief councilor, appointed military governor of Zhenzhou and concurrently magistrate of Henan, and assigned to oversee the six armies and all guard units.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔天下見禁罪人，委所在長吏躬親慮問，疾速疏決。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict ordered that prisoners held throughout the realm be entrusted to local chief officials for personal examination and prompt disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, an edict ordered that prisoners held throughout the realm be entrusted to local chief officials for personal review and swift disposition.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸至德宮，因幸房知溫、安元信、範延光、索自通、李從敏第。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue, and then visited the residences of Fang Zhiwen, An Yuanxin, Fan Yanguang, Suo Zitong, and Li Congmin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue, and then called at the homes of Fang Zhiwen, An Yuanxin, Fan Yanguang, Suo Zitong, and Li Congmin.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以檢校太子太傅致仕王建立為檢校太尉、兼侍中、鄆州節度使；

translations.literal: On renwu, Wang Jianli, who had retired as honorary grand tutor of the heir apparent, was made honorary grand marshal, chief steward, and military governor of Yanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wang Jianli, who had retired as honorary grand tutor of the heir apparent, was appointed honorary grand marshal, chief steward, and military governor of Yanzhou;

sentences.zh: 以前宋州節度使安元信為檢校太尉、兼侍中、潞州節度使。

translations.literal: An Yuanxin, former military governor of Songzhou, was made honorary grand marshal, chief steward, and military governor of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An Yuanxin, former military governor of Songzhou, was appointed honorary grand marshal, chief steward, and military governor of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，三司使劉煦奏：「天下戶民，自天成二年括定秋夏田稅，迨今八年。

translations.literal: On guimi, Liu Xu, commissioner of the Three Departments, memorialized: "The households throughout the realm have had their autumn and summer field taxes fixed since the second year of Tiancheng—eight years to date.
translations.idiomatic: On guimi, Liu Xu, commissioner of the Three Departments, memorialized: "Households throughout the realm have had their autumn and summer field taxes assessed since the second year of Tiancheng—eight years to date.

sentences.zh: 近者相次有百姓詣闕訴田不均，累行蠲放，漸失稅額，望差朝臣一概檢視。

translations.literal: Recently common people have come to court one after another complaining of unequal land assessment; repeated exemptions have gradually eroded the tax quota. We request that court officials be dispatched to conduct a uniform inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Recently commoners have come to court in succession to complain of unequal land assessments; repeated exemptions have gradually eroded the tax quota. We request that court officials be dispatched to conduct a uniform review.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No response.
translations.idiomatic: " No response.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝為故皇子亳州刺史重吉、皇長女尼惠明大師幼澄舉哀行服，群臣詣閣門奉慰。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Emperor observed mourning for the late prince Chongji, former prefect of Bozhou, and the eldest imperial daughter, the nun Huiming dashi Youcheng; the officials came to the Gate of Audience to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor went into mourning for the late prince Chongji, former prefect of Bozhou, and for his eldest imperial daughter, the nun Huiming dashi Youcheng; the officials came to the Gate of Audience to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 帝起兵之始，重吉、幼澄俱為閔帝所害。

translations.literal: When the Emperor first raised his army, both Chongji and Youcheng were killed by Emperor Min.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first rose in arms, both Chongji and Youcheng had been killed by Emperor Min.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以戶部侍郎韓彥惲為絳州刺史，以左武衛上將軍李肅為單州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Han Yanyun, vice minister of revenue, was made prefect of Jiangzhou; Li Su, general of the Left Martial Guard, was made prefect of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Han Yanyun, vice minister of revenue, was appointed prefect of Jiangzhou, and Li Su, general of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed prefect of Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，襄州節度使趙在禮加同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xiangzhou, was given the additional title of fellow chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xiangzhou, was given the additional title of fellow chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以武勝軍留後張承祐為華州節度使；

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhang Chengyou, acting military governor of Wusheng, was made military governor of Huazhou;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhang Chengyou, acting military governor of Wusheng, was appointed military governor of Huazhou;

sentences.zh: 以皇城使宋審虔為壽州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Song Shenqian, commissioner of the Imperial City, was made military governor of Shouzhou and appointed commander-in-chief of the infantry of the imperial guard;
translations.idiomatic: Song Shenqian, commissioner of the Imperial City, was appointed military governor of Shouzhou and commander-in-chief of the imperial guard infantry;

sentences.zh: 以右衛上將軍劉仲殷為宋州節度使；

translations.literal: Liu Zhongyin, general of the Right Guard, was made military governor of Songzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhongyin, general of the Right Guard, was appointed military governor of Songzhou;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、壽州節度使皇甫遇為鄧州節度使；

translations.literal: Huangfu Yu, commander-in-chief of the infantry of the imperial guard and military governor of Shouzhou, was made military governor of Dengzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu, commander-in-chief of the imperial guard infantry and military governor of Shouzhou, was appointed military governor of Dengzhou;

sentences.zh: 以前華州節度使華溫琪為太子太傅致仕。

translations.literal: Hua Wenqi, former military governor of Huazhou, retired as grand tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Wenqi, former military governor of Huazhou, retired as grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，左神武統軍周知裕卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Zhou Zhiyu, commander of the Left Spirit Martial Guard, died; he was posthumously given the title of grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhou Zhiyu, commander of the Left Spirit Martial Guard, died and was posthumously given the title of grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師大旱，熱甚，暍死者百餘人。

translations.literal: That month the capital suffered a great drought and intense heat; more than a hundred people died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital suffered severe drought and blistering heat; more than a hundred people died of heatstroke.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，太子少保致仕崔沂卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengzi, Cui Yi, who had retired as junior guardian of the heir apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengzi, Cui Yi, who had retired as junior guardian of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鳳翔進偽蜀孟知祥來書，稱「大蜀皇帝獻書於大唐皇帝」，且言「見迫群情，以今年四月十二日即皇帝位」雲，帝不答。

translations.literal: On guimao, Fengxiang submitted a letter from Meng Zhixiang of rebel Shu, which read "The Emperor of Great Shu presents this letter to the Emperor of Great Tang," and also stated "Compelled by public sentiment, I assumed the imperial throne on the twelfth day of the fourth month of this year"—the Emperor made no reply.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Fengxiang submitted a letter from Meng Zhixiang of rebel Shu, which read "The Emperor of Great Shu presents this letter to the Emperor of Great Tang," and also stated that, "compelled by public sentiment, I assumed the imperial throne on the twelfth day of the fourth month of this year"—the Emperor made no reply.

sentences.zh: 以前武州刺史鄭琮為右衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Zheng Cong, former prefect of Wuzhou, was made general of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Cong, former prefect of Wuzhou, was appointed general of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸龍門佛寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇子故亳州團練使重吉贈太尉，仍於宋州置廟。

translations.literal: On yisi, the late prince Chongji, former regimental commander of Bozhou, was posthumously given the title of grand marshal; a temple was also established at Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the late prince Chongji, former regimental commander of Bozhou, was posthumously given the title of grand marshal, and a temple was established at Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，鳳翔節度使李從嚴封西平王。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Li Congyan, military governor of Fengxiang, was enfeoffed as King of Western Ping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Li Congyan, military governor of Fengxiang, was enfeoffed as King of Western Ping.

sentences.zh: 是日，宰臣李愚、劉煦因論公事，於政事堂相詬，辭甚鄙惡，帝令樞密副使劉延朗宣諭曰：「卿等輔弼之臣，不宜如是，今後不得更然。

translations.literal: That day Chief Councillors Li Yu and Liu Xu quarreled over official business in the Hall of Governance, their language most vulgar and foul. The Emperor had Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Liu Yanlang proclaim: "You are ministers who assist and counsel; you should not act thus. Hereafter you must not do so again."
translations.idiomatic: That day Chief Councillors Li Yu and Liu Xu quarreled over official business in the Hall of Governance, using language most vulgar and foul. The Emperor had Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Liu Yanlang proclaim: "You are ministers who assist and counsel; you should not act thus. Hereafter you must not do so again."

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，以太常卿盧文紀為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: " On xinhai, Lu Wenji, grand master of ceremonies, was made vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinhai, Lu Wenji, grand master of ceremonies, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 是日，中書門下三上章請立中宮，從之。

translations.literal: That day the Secretariat submitted three memorials requesting the establishment of an empress; granted.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Secretariat submitted three memorials requesting the establishment of an empress; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，製立沛國夫人劉氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On dingsi, by imperial decree Lady Liu of the Pei State was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, by imperial decree Lady Liu of Pei State was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太子少傅陳皋卒。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chen Gao, junior tutor of the heir apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chen Gao, junior tutor of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，史官張昭遠以所撰莊宗朝列傳三十卷上之。

translations.literal: On yichou, the historiographer Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted the thirty fascicles of Biographies of the Zhuangzong Court that he had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the historiographer Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted the thirty fascicles of Biographies of the Zhuangzong Court that he had compiled.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，詔蠲放長興四年十二月已前天下所欠殘稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengwu, an edict remitted unpaid residual taxes throughout the realm owed before the twelfth month of the fourth year of Changxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu, an edict remitted unpaid residual taxes throughout the realm owed before the twelfth month of the fourth year of Changxing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以前尚書左丞姚顗為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yao Yi, former left vice director of the Ministry of Revenue, was made vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yao Yi, former left vice director of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 詔應曾受禦署官逐攝同一任正官，依期限赴選。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all who had received imperially commissioned appointments were, upon completing one term of acting appointment, to proceed to selection according to the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all who had received imperially commissioned appointments were, upon completing one term of acting service, to proceed to regular selection according to the deadline.

sentences.zh: （徐無黨《五代史注》云：禦署官，疑是廢帝初舉兵時所置之官，以其非吏部正授，故須有旨方得選。）〉

translations.literal: (Xu Wudang's "Annotations on the History of the Five Dynasties" states: Imperially commissioned officials were probably offices established when the deposed emperor first raised his army; because they were not regular appointments from the Ministry of Personnel, imperial authorization was required before they could enter selection.)]
translations.idiomatic: (Per Xu Wudang's "Annotations on the History of the Five Dynasties": Imperially commissioned officials were probably offices established when the deposed emperor first raised his army; because they were not regular appointments from the Ministry of Personnel, imperial authorization was required before they could enter selection.)]

sentences.zh: 荊南奏，偽蜀孟知祥卒，其子昶嗣偽位。

translations.literal: Jingnan reported that Meng Zhixiang of rebel Shu had died and his son Chang had succeeded to the usurped throne.
translations.idiomatic: Jingnan reported that Meng Zhixiang of rebel Shu had died and that his son Chang had succeeded to the usurped throne.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以尚書禮部侍郎鄭韜光為刑部侍郎，以前工部侍郎楊凝式為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renshen, Zheng Taoguang, vice minister of rites of the Ministry of Revenue, was made vice minister of justice; Yang Ningshi, former vice minister of works, was made vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zheng Taoguang, vice minister of rites of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed vice minister of justice, and Yang Ningshi, former vice minister of works, was appointed vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以前金州防禦使婁繼英為右神武統軍，以右神武統軍高允貞為左神武統軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Lou Jiying, former defender of Jinzhou, was made commander of the Right Spirit Martial Guard; Gao Yunzhen, commander of the Right Spirit Martial Guard, was made commander of the Left Spirit Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Lou Jiying, former defender of Jinzhou, was appointed commander of the Right Spirit Martial Guard, and Gao Yunzhen, commander of the Right Spirit Martial Guard, was appointed commander of the Left Spirit Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以翰林學士承旨、工部尚書、知制誥李懌為太常卿；

translations.literal: On yihai, Li Yin, chief academician of the Hanlin Academy, minister of works, and drafter of edicts, was made grand master of ceremonies;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Yin, chief academician of the Hanlin Academy, minister of works, and drafter of edicts, was appointed grand master of ceremonies;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、戶部侍郎、知制誥程遜為學士承旨。

translations.literal: Cheng Xun, Hanlin academician, vice minister of revenue, and drafter of edicts, was made chief academician.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xun, Hanlin academician, vice minister of revenue, and drafter of edicts, was appointed chief academician.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以兵部侍郎龍敏為吏部侍郎，以秘書監崔居儉為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Long Min, vice minister of war, was made vice minister of personnel; Cui Jujian, director of the Secretariat, was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Long Min, vice minister of war, was appointed vice minister of personnel, and Cui Jujian, director of the Secretariat, was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以右武衛上將軍張繼祚為右衛上將軍；

translations.literal: On yiyou, Zhang Jizuo, general of the Right Martial Guard, was made general of the Right Guard;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhang Jizuo, general of the Right Martial Guard, was appointed general of the Right Guard;

sentences.zh: 以右驍衛上將軍王景戡為左衛上將軍；

translations.literal: Wang Jingcan, general of the Right Brave Guard, was made general of the Left Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingcan, general of the Right Brave Guard, was appointed general of the Left Guard;

sentences.zh: 以右領衛上將軍劉衛為左武衛上將軍；

translations.literal: Liu Wei, general of the Right Leading Guard, was made general of the Left Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wei, general of the Right Leading Guard, was appointed general of the Left Martial Guard;

sentences.zh: 以右千牛上將軍王陟為右領軍上將軍；

translations.literal: Wang Zhi, general of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, was made general of the Right Leading Army;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi, general of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, was appointed general of the Right Leading Army;

sentences.zh: 以司農卿兼通事舍人，判四方館事王景崇為鴻臚卿，依前通事舍人、判四方館。

translations.literal: Wang Jingchong, minister of agriculture concurrently chief usher and manager of foreign affairs at the Office for Receiving Envoys from the Four Directions, was made grand minister of foreign affairs, retaining his posts as chief usher and manager of the Office for Receiving Envoys from the Four Directions.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingchong, minister of agriculture concurrently chief usher and manager of the Office for Receiving Envoys from the Four Directions, was appointed grand minister of foreign affairs, retaining his posts as chief usher and manager of the Office for Receiving Envoys from the Four Directions.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，右龍武統軍索自通卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Suo Zitong, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Suo Zitong, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禮部尚書致仕李光憲卒。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Li Guangxian, who had retired as minister of rites, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Guangxian, who had retired as minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以太子少傅盧質為太子少師。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Lu Zhi, junior tutor of the heir apparent, was made junior mentor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Lu Zhi, junior tutor of the heir apparent, was appointed junior mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以前邢州節度使趙鳳為太子太保。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Zhao Feng, former military governor of Xingzhou, was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhao Feng, former military governor of Xingzhou, was appointed grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 詔：「文武百官差使，宜令依倫次，中書置簿，不得重疊。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "For the dispatch of civil and military officials on missions, they should be assigned in order of precedence; the Secretariat shall keep a register and assignments must not overlap.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "When civil and military officials are dispatched on missions, assignments should follow order of precedence; the Secretariat shall keep a register, and assignments must not overlap.

sentences.zh: 若當使者自緣有事，或不欲行者，注簿便當一使。

translations.literal: If the officer whose turn it is has personal business or does not wish to go, the register should advance to the next eligible envoy.
translations.idiomatic: If the officer whose turn it is has personal business or does not wish to go, the register should advance to the next eligible envoy.

sentences.zh: 自長興三年正月後已曾奉使者，便為簿首；

translations.literal: Those who have already served on mission since the first month of the third year of Changxing shall be placed at the head of the register;
translations.idiomatic: Those who have already served on mission since the first month of the third year of Changxing shall be placed at the head of the register;

sentences.zh: 已後差者，次第注之。

translations.literal: thereafter successive appointees are to be entered in order."
translations.idiomatic: thereafter successive appointees are to be entered in order."

sentences.zh: 」 有司上言：「皇后受冊，內外命婦上箋無答教。

translations.literal: The relevant officials submitted a memorial: "When the empress receives her investiture, the inner and outer titled ladies submit congratulatory letters without receiving a written reply in return.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant officials memorialized: "When the empress receives her investiture, the inner and outer titled ladies submit congratulatory letters without receiving a written reply in return.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，禦文明殿冊皇后，命使攝太尉、宰臣盧文紀，使副攝司徒、右諫議大夫盧損指皇后宮，行禮畢，恩賜有差。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Emperor invested the empress in the Hall of Civil Splendor; the envoy acting as grand marshal was Chief Councillor Lu Wenji, and the deputy envoy acting as minister of education was Right Remonstrance and Counsel Grandee Lu Sun, who directed the ceremony at the empress's palace; when the rites were complete, gracious awards were distributed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Emperor invested the empress in the Hall of Civil Splendor; Chief Councillor Lu Wenji served as envoy acting as grand marshal, and Right Remonstrance and Counsel Grandee Lu Sun served as deputy envoy acting as minister of education, directing the ceremony at the empress's palace; when the rites were complete, gracious awards were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，以久雨，分命朝臣營都城門，告宗廟社稷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai, because of prolonged rain, court officials were dispatched in turn to repair the capital gates and report to the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jihai, because of prolonged rain, court officials were dispatched in turn to repair the capital gates and report to the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夜有星如五斗器，西南流，尾跡長數丈，屈曲如龍形。

translations.literal: On xinchou, at night a star like a five-peck measure flowed southwest; its trail was several rods long, twisting like a dragon.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, at night a star like a five-peck measure flowed southwest; its trail was several rods long and twisted like a dragon.

sentences.zh: 又眾星亂流，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Many other stars flowed in disorder, beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Many other stars streamed in disorder, beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 京師大雨，雹如彈丸。

translations.literal: The capital suffered heavy rain; hail like sling stones fell.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered heavy rain, and hail fell like sling stones.

sentences.zh: 曹州刺史藥縱之卒。

translations.literal: Yao Zongzhi, prefect of Caozhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zongzhi, prefect of Caozhou, died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以霖霪甚，詔都下諸獄委御史台憲錄問，諸州縣差判官令錄親自錄問，畫時疏理。

translations.literal: On jiachen, because the rains had been especially prolonged, an edict ordered that prisons in the capital be entrusted to the censorate for judicial examination; in prefectures and counties judges, magistrates, and recorders were to conduct examinations in person, and cases were to be cleared promptly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, because the rains had been especially prolonged, an edict ordered that prisons in the capital be entrusted to the censorate for judicial examination; in prefectures and counties judges, magistrates, and recorders were to examine cases in person, and cases were to be cleared within the day.

sentences.zh: 壬子，中書門下舉行長興三年敕，常年薦送舉人，州郡行鄉飲酒之時，帖太常草定儀注奏聞。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Secretariat put into effect the edict of the third year of Changxing: when prefectures annually recommended candidates for examination, at the time of the village drinking ceremony, the draft ritual protocol from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was to be posted and reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Secretariat put into effect the edict of the third year of Changxing: when prefectures annually recommended candidates for examination, at the time of the village drinking ceremony the draft ritual protocol from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was to be posted and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以前潞州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事盧文進為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Lu Wenjin, former military governor of Luzhou, honorary grand marshal, and fellow chief councilor, was made military governor of Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lu Wenjin, former military governor of Luzhou, honorary grand marshal, and fellow chief councilor, was appointed military governor of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，雲州奏，契丹寇境。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Yunzhou reported that the Khitan had raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yunzhou reported that the Khitan had raided the border.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，有雉金色，止於中書政事堂。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinwei, a golden pheasant alighted in the Secretariat Hall of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on xinwei, a golden pheasant alighted in the Secretariat Hall of Governance.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏：「請以正月二十三日皇帝誕慶日為千春節。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "We request that the twenty-third day of the first month, the Emperor's birthday, be established as the Festival of a Thousand Springs."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: "We request that the twenty-third day of the first month, the Emperor's birthday, be established as the Festival of a Thousand Springs."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，宰臣李愚、劉煦罷相，以愚守左僕射，煦守右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Chief Councillors Li Yu and Liu Xu were removed as chief councilors; Li Yu was made left vice director and Liu Xu right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Chief Councillors Li Yu and Liu Xu were removed as chief councilors; Li Yu was made left vice director and Liu Xu right vice director.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇雲、應州，詔河東節度使石敬瑭率兵屯代州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Yun and Ying prefectures; an edict ordered Shi Jingtang, military governor of Hedong, to lead troops and encamp at Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan raided Yun and Ying prefectures; an edict ordered Shi Jingtang, military governor of Hedong, to lead troops and encamp at Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宰臣姚顗奏：「吏部三銓，近年並為一司，望令依舊分銓。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Chief Councillor Yao Yi memorialized: "The three bureaus of selection in the Ministry of Personnel have recently been merged into one office; we request that they be divided again as formerly."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Chief Councillor Yao Yi memorialized: "The three bureaus of selection in the Ministry of Personnel have recently been merged into one office; we request that they be divided again as formerly."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以左衛上將軍李宏元卒廢朝，贈司徒。

translations.literal: On xinmao, because Li Hongyuan, general of the Left Guard, had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given the title of minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, because Li Hongyuan, general of the Left Guard, had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given the title of minister of education.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以禮部郎中、知制誥呂琦守本官，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: On guisi, Lü Qi, director of the sixth rank in the Ministry of Rites and drafter of edicts, retained his current post and was appointed direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Lü Qi, director of the sixth rank in the Ministry of Rites and drafter of edicts, retained his current post and was appointed direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，以刑部侍郎鄭韜光為尚書右丞，以光祿少卿烏昭遠為少府監。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou, Zheng Taoguang, vice minister of justice, was made right vice director of the Ministry of Revenue; Wu Zhaoyuan, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made director of the Directorate of Palace Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou, Zheng Taoguang, vice minister of justice, was appointed right vice director of the Ministry of Revenue, and Wu Zhaoyuan, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed director of the Directorate of Palace Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 秦州節度使張延郎奏，率師伐蜀。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanlang, military governor of Qinzhou, memorialized that he was leading troops to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang, military governor of Qinzhou, memorialized that he was leading troops to attack Shu.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏：「二十六日明宗忌，陛下初遇忌辰，不同常歲，請於忌辰前後各一日不坐朝。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "The twenty-sixth is Mingzong's death anniversary; as Your Majesty encounters this observance for the first time, unlike ordinary years, we request that court audiences be suspended one day before and one day after the anniversary."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: "The twenty-sixth is Mingzong's death anniversary; as Your Majesty encounters this observance for the first time, unlike ordinary years, we request that court audiences be suspended one day before and one day after the anniversary."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 御史台奏：「前任節度使、刺史、行軍副使，雖每日於便殿起居，每遇五日起居，亦合綴班。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "Former military governors, prefects, and deputy field commanders, though they attend daily audiences in the informal hall, should also take their places in the formal ranks whenever the five-day audience is held."
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate memorialized: "Former military governors, prefects, and deputy field commanders, though they attend daily audiences in the informal hall, should also take their places in the formal ranks whenever the five-day audience is held."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以前興州刺史馮暉配同州衙前安置。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Feng Hui, former prefect of Xingzhou, was exiled to serve as a yamen runner at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Feng Hui, former prefect of Xingzhou, was exiled to serve as a yamen runner at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 暉為興州刺史，屯乾渠，蜀人來侵，暉自屯所奔歸鳳翔，故有是責。

translations.literal: Hui had been prefect of Xingzhou and garrisoned Ganqu; when Shu forces invaded, he fled from his post back to Fengxiang—hence this punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had been prefect of Xingzhou and garrisoned Ganqu; when Shu forces invaded, he fled from his post back to Fengxiang—hence this punishment.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔振武、新州、河東西北邊經契丹蹂踐處，放免三年兩稅差配，時契丹初退故也。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict remitted the twice-yearly tax levies and corvée assignments for three years in the regions of Zhenwu, Xinzhou, and the northwestern border of Hedong that had been trampled by the Khitan—because the Khitan had only just withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, an edict remitted the twice-yearly tax levies and corvée assignments for three years in the regions of Zhenwu, Xinzhou, and the northwestern border of Hedong that had been trampled by the Khitan—because the Khitan had only just withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前華州節度使王萬榮為左驍衛上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On guichou, Wang Wanrong, former military governor of Huazhou, retired as general of the Left Brave Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wang Wanrong, former military governor of Huazhou, retired as general of the Left Brave Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以振武節度使楊光遠充大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍兵馬都虞候，以前右金吾大將軍穆延暉為右武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Zhenwu, was appointed overall deputy commander of the cavalry and infantry of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies; Mu Yanhui, former great general of the Right Golden Fowl Guard, was made general of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Zhenwu, was appointed overall deputy commander of the cavalry and infantry of the Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, and Mu Yanhui, former great general of the Right Golden Fowl Guard, was appointed general of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以禮部侍郎楊凝式為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yang Ningshi, vice minister of rites, was made vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yang Ningshi, vice minister of rites, was appointed vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以中書舍人盧導為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Lu Dao, drafting official of the Secretariat, was made vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lu Dao, drafting official of the Secretariat, was appointed vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯朔，詔修奉本朝諸帝陵寢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, the first day, an edict ordered the repair and maintenance of the tombs of all emperors of this dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, the first day, an edict ordered the repair and maintenance of the tombs of all emperors of this dynasty.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以北面馬軍都指揮使、易州刺史安叔千為安北都護、振武節度使；

translations.literal: On jisi, An Shuqian, cavalry commander of the northern armies and prefect of Yizhou, was made protector-general of pacifying the north and military governor of Zhenwu;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, An Shuqian, cavalry commander of the northern armies and prefect of Yizhou, was appointed protector-general of pacifying the north and military governor of Zhenwu;

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使尹暉為彰國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Yin Hui, defender of Qizhou, was made military governor of the Zhangguo army.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hui, defender of Qizhou, was appointed military governor of the Zhangguo army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔葬庶人從榮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict ordered the burial of the commoner Congrong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, an edict ordered the burial of the commoner Congrong.

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「依貞觀中庶人承乾，以公禮葬。

translations.literal: The relevant officials submitted a memorial: "Following the precedent of the deposed heir Chengqian in the Zhenguan era, let him be buried with public rites."
translations.idiomatic: The relevant officials memorialized: "Following the precedent of the deposed heir Chengqian in the Zhenguan era, let him be buried with public rites."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Granted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以秦州節度使張延朗為中書侍郎、同平章事、判三司；

translations.literal: On yihai, Zhang Yanlang, military governor of Qinzhou, was made vice director of the Secretariat, fellow chief councilor, and manager of the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Yanlang, military governor of Qinzhou, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat, fellow chief councilor, and manager of the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：二年三月，宰臣張延朗奏：「臣判三司公事，每日內殿祗候，其合綴前班押班，伏乞特免。

translations.literal: (The "Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties": In the third month of the second year, chief minister Zhang Yanlang memorialized: "As I am managing the affairs of the Three Departments, I attend daily in the inner hall; as I ought to join the front ranks to lead the procession, I humbly request a special exemption."
translations.idiomatic: (Per the "Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties": In the third month of the second year, chief minister Zhang Yanlang memorialized: "As I am managing the affairs of the Three Departments, I attend daily in the inner hall; as I ought to join the front ranks to lead the procession, I humbly request a special exemption."

translations.literal: " It was granted."])
translations.idiomatic: " Granted."])

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事盧文紀為門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史；

translations.literal: Lu Wenji, vice director of the Secretariat and co-manager of affairs, was made vice director of the Chancellery, co-manager of affairs, and supervisor of the compilation of the national history;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenji, vice director of the secretariat and co-manager of state affairs, was appointed vice director of the chancellery, co-manager of state affairs, and supervisor of the national history;

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事姚顗兼集賢院大學士；

translations.literal: Yao Yan, vice director of the Secretariat and co-manager of affairs, was additionally made grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yan, vice director of the secretariat and co-manager of state affairs, was additionally named grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies;

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使康福為秦州節度使。

translations.literal: Kang Fu, former military commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Fu, former military commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was appointed military commissioner of Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，夜有白氣，東西亙天。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, at night there was white vapor spanning east to west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, white vapor appeared at night, stretching from east to west across the heavens.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸龍門祈雪，自九月至是無雨雪故也。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Emperor visited Longmen to pray for snow, because from the ninth month until then there had been no rain or snow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor went to Longmen to pray for snow, for from the ninth month until then there had been neither rain nor snow.
